parts.instructions: You are a new member of the club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Use 20-30 words.
parts.prompt: What do you usually talk about with your friends?

parts.instructions: You are communicating with other members of the club in the chat room. Reply to their questions. Write in sentences. Use 30-40 words per answer.

chatMessages.messageText: There are many ways to follow the news nowadays. How do you get the world news?
I will be participating in a review in front of 50 people next week. How can I make a good impression?
Before making a decision about something you should consider both sides of the issue, what do you think about the opinion?

parts.instructions: You are a member of the club. Read the notice from the club president/manager and write the requested emails.
parts.managerNotice:
"We want to encourage more young people to join the club. Unfortunately, young people often think that argument is not for them. What do you think is the benefit of learning debating skills and public speaking? Give two benefits that you think are the most important and why?"
Q1: Write an email to your friend, who is also a member of our club. Tell your friend what suggestions you will make and why. Write about 50 words.
Q2: Write an email to the manager of the club. Write about your ideas and what you think about the situation. Write about 120-150 words.

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your friend who is also a member of Debate club. Express your thoughts and feelings about the announcement and suggest what you both should do.
Write an email to the president/manager of Debate club. Give your detailed feedback, propose constructive solutions for the initiative, and explain why your suggestions would benefit the club.
